landmarks.name: India Gate
landmarks.scope: Stone arch; architectural details approximated from reference photographs.

landmarks.name: Lotus Temple
landmarks.scope: 27 petal shells; shell curvature and height nominal. Surrounding pools and grounds are not reconstructed.

landmarks.name: Qutb Minar
landmarks.scope: Five-storey tower with fluting, stone bands and balconies; carvings simplified.

landmarks.name: Red Fort · Lahori Gate
landmarks.scope: Lahori Gate only, on its mapped footprint; towers, chhatris and battlements approximated. The full fort is not reconstructed.

landmarks.name: Rashtrapati Bhavan
landmarks.scope: Main palace with central dome, colonnaded portico, courtyard wings and chhatris. Height referenced to the forecourt; facade details and internal layout approximated. Presidential Estate, gardens and Jaipur Column are not reconstructed.

landmarks.name: Supreme Court of India
landmarks.scope: Original main building: central dome, colonnaded verandah and symmetrical wings. Dome height source-backed; wing proportions and details approximate. Additional Building Complex and interior access are not reconstructed.

landmarks.name: Hanuman Statue · Jhandewalan
landmarks.scope: 108-foot Hanuman murti at Sankat Mochan Dham near Jhandewalan. Approximate directory location; no verified footprint. Crown, mace, tail and hands at the chest are original stylized geometry. Width, depth, pose details and heading nominal; chest opening is not animated.

landmarks.name: Nexus Select CITYWALK · Saket
landmarks.scope: Mapped mall outline, including both separate polygon parts. Facades, glass bands, roof details and 24 m height are nominal; shop interiors and the neighbouring hotel are not reconstructed.

landmarks.name: DLF Avenue · Saket
landmarks.scope: Both mapped mall polygon parts retained. Retail massing, facade, roof details and 20 m height are nominal; internal shops and the outdoor plaza are not reconstructed.

landmarks.name: DLF Promenade · Vasant Kunj
landmarks.scope: Main mapped mall building. Facade glazing, cornices, roof lantern and 22 m height are nominal; adjacent shopping centres remain separate places.

landmarks.name: DLF Emporio · Vasant Kunj
landmarks.scope: Mapped luxury mall building with original pale-stone facade interpretation. Windows, facade details and 22 m height are nominal; shop interiors are not reconstructed.

landmarks.name: Ambience Mall · Vasant Kunj
landmarks.scope: Mapped Vasant Kunj mall building, retaining its courtyard hole. Glazing, floor bands, rooftop details and 24 m height are nominal. This is not Ambience Mall in Gurugram.

landmarks.name: Pacific Mall · NSP
landmarks.scope: Mapped NSP mall building. Facade glazing, floor bands, roof detail and 24 m height are nominal; separate from Pacific Mall at Tagore Garden.

landmarks.name: Pacific Mall · Tagore Garden
landmarks.scope: Mapped retail grounds shown as a site outline. The source is a land parcel, not a verified mall building footprint; no building, entrances or shop layout are invented. Highlight thickness 0.4 m is nominal.

landmarks.name: Vegas Mall · Dwarka
landmarks.scope: Mapped mall grounds shown as a site outline. The source identifies a commercial parcel; the checked local map has no verified mall building footprint. No building or piazza geometry is invented. Highlight thickness 0.4 m is nominal.

landmarks.name: National Zoological Park · Delhi Zoo
landmarks.scope: Actual mapped zoo boundary shown as a green site outline. Existing mapped city context remains visible. Habitats, animals, internal buildings and visitor entrances are not reconstructed; no animal simulation is implied. Highlight thickness 0.4 m is nominal.

landmarks.name: Humayun’s Tomb
landmarks.scope: Mausoleum and mapped square plinth, with red sandstone arcades, white double dome and chhatris. Overall height 45 m, architectural proportions and details are nominal. The garden, tomb complex and adjacent museum are not reconstructed.
conflicts: OSM Wikidata Q486188 identifies Emperor Humayun rather than the tomb; identity checked by name, historic/building tags and source reference. OSM height=3 on this square outline is not treated as the complete mausoleum height.

landmarks.name: Safdarjung’s Tomb
landmarks.scope: Main mapped mausoleum with sandstone facades, corner pavilions and pale dome. Height 30 m and architectural details are nominal; the surrounding garden and enclosure are not reconstructed.
conflicts: OSM Wikidata Q391381 identifies Safdarjung rather than the tomb; identity checked by name, historic/building tags and source reference.

landmarks.name: Purana Qila · Bara Darwaza
landmarks.scope: Western main gate (Bara/Bada Darwaza) only, on its mapped footprint. Bastions, vaulted entrance, chhatris and 20 m height are nominal. The whole fort and its interior monuments are not reconstructed.

landmarks.name: Jama Masjid · Old Delhi
landmarks.scope: Mapped mosque outline including its open courtyard. Three pale domes, paired minarets, sandstone arcades and the nominal 40 m model height are approximate; interior details and access are not reconstructed.

landmarks.name: Swaminarayan Akshardham
landmarks.scope: Main mandir only, on its mapped footprint. Overall height rounded from the official 141.3 feet. Nine-domed silhouette, tiered mandapas, columns and carvings are approximate. The full campus, exhibitions and fountain are not reconstructed. The mapped outline is smaller than the official plan dimensions; the model follows the mapped outline.
conflicts: The OSM outline (about 73 by 63 m) is smaller than the official 316 by 356 foot mandir plan dimensions. The model retains mapped XY geography rather than expanding it to an unverified outline.

landmarks.name: Jantar Mantar · Samrat Yantra
landmarks.scope: Samrat Yantra only, on its mapped instrument footprint. Triangular gnomon, stair and quadrants are an architectural interpretation; dimensions and height 18 m are nominal. Other instruments are not reconstructed.

landmarks.name: Raj Ghat · Gandhi Memorial
landmarks.scope: Mapped memorial platform with a black stone slab and simplified flame. Height 1.5 m and stone/flame details are nominal; surrounding gardens and other memorials are not reconstructed.
conflicts: OSM Wikidata Q1001 identifies Mahatma Gandhi rather than this memorial; identity checked by name, historic tag and source reference.

landmarks.name: Agrasen ki Baoli
landmarks.scope: Raised cutaway illustration of the mapped stepwell, showing descending steps and side arcades. The real well is sunken; this 8 m display height, step count, depth and masonry details are nominal. This model does not represent a surveyed excavation or visitor route.

landmarks.name: DLF Mall of India · Noida
landmarks.scope: Mapped Noida mall building. Facades, glazing, signage and 30 m height are nominal; underground floors and shop interiors are not reconstructed. Separate from the similarly named Gurugram development.

landmarks.name: The Great India Place · Noida
landmarks.scope: Mapped main mall building only. Facade details and 24 m height are nominal; Gardens Galleria, Worlds of Wonder and the wider Entertainment City campus are not reconstructed.

landmarks.name: India Expo Mart · Greater Noida
landmarks.scope: Mapped mart building only, with nominal exhibition-building facade and 18 m height. The complete exhibition campus, halls, interiors and visitor access are not reconstructed.

landmarks.name: Mahagun Metro Mall · Vaishali
landmarks.scope: Mapped mall building. Facades, glazing and 26 m height are nominal; adjacent hotel, shop interiors and the wider retail parcel are not reconstructed.

landmarks.name: Pacific Mall · Sahibabad
landmarks.scope: Mapped retail parcel shown as an open site outline. This is not a verified building footprint; no mall building, entrances or shop layout are invented. Existing city context remains visible. Highlight thickness 0.4 m is nominal.

landmarks.name: Shopprix Mall · Meerut
landmarks.scope: Mapped Meerut mall building. Facades, glazing and 24 m height are nominal; neighbouring hotels and shop interiors are not reconstructed. Separate from Shopprix malls in Noida and Ghaziabad.

landmarks.name: Gandhi Bagh · Meerut
landmarks.scope: Mapped park boundary shown as an open site outline. Existing city trees/buildings remain visible; gardens, fountains, entrances and visitor paths are not reconstructed. Highlight thickness 0.4 m is nominal.

landmarks.name: Okhla Bird Sanctuary
landmarks.scope: Mapped sanctuary boundary shown as an open site outline across the Yamuna wetland. Existing water and city context remain visible. Habitats, birds, watchtowers, entrances and visitor paths are not reconstructed. Highlight thickness 0.4 m is nominal.

landmarks.name: City Forest · Ghaziabad
landmarks.scope: Mapped nature-reserve boundary shown as an open site outline, distinct from the Gopi Sarover pond inside it. Existing city context remains visible; internal gardens, rides, buildings, entrances and paths are not reconstructed. Highlight thickness 0.4 m is nominal.

landmarks.name: Augharnath Temple · Meerut
landmarks.scope: Mapped worship-site boundary shown as an open site outline. The source does not verify a temple-building footprint; shrines, spires, entrances and internal layout are not reconstructed. Existing city context remains visible. Highlight thickness 0.4 m is nominal.

landmarks.name: ISKCON Temple · Ghaziabad
aliases: Sri Sri Radha Madan Mohan Temple
landmarks.scope: Mapped Raj Nagar temple building. Original stylized temple massing, spires, colonnade and 24 m height are nominal; interiors and visitor access are not reconstructed. Separate from ISKCON Noida and Wave City.
